description: The plot illustrates how average performance metrics (Precision, Recall, and F1-score) vary with model size. The x-axis is labeled “Model Size (log scale)” and uses a logarithmic scale with discrete tick labels at 70m, 160m, 410m, 1.0B, 1.4B, 2.8B, and 7.0B. The y-axis is labeled “Avg. Performance (%)” on a linear scale, spanning roughly from 0 to 80%, with labeled ticks at 20, 40, 60, and 80. Three lines are shown: Precision is a red solid line with upward-pointing triangle markers, starting near 79% at 70m, decreasing to about 76% at 160m and about 71% at 410m, then rising gradually through roughly 72–73% at 1.0B–1.4B, about 74% at 2.8B, and ending near 77–78% at 7.0B. Recall is a blue solid line with upward-pointing triangle markers, increasing steadily from about 10% at 70m to about 13% at 160m, about 20% at 410m, about 25% at 1.0B, about 26% at 1.4B, about 32% at 2.8B, and about 45% at 7.0B. F1-score is a purple solid line with upward-pointing triangle markers, also increasing across the x-axis from about 15% at 70m to about 19% at 160m, about 30% at 410m, about 38% at 1.0B, about 40% at 1.4B, about 48% at 2.8B, and about 56% at 7.0B.
